title: Rock 'n' Roll Revival
course: UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma in Creative Practice, Art, Design and Communication
materials: Cotton fabric, recycled garments, leather fabric and silk
body: My design is about a 50s-inspired outfit for a classic 1950s film, including the themes of one of my favourite films I have grown up with, Grease, the 50s icons Marilyn Monroe and Audrey Hepburn, and the influence of the 50s Cadillac Coupe Deville.
